whole_report_rule: Successful processing; no missing/extra observations or candidates; all candidate checks and normalized core fields correct; issue flags match; all quotes exact and complete. Exact time_text differences reported separately and reviewed for semantic validity.

regression.finding: Baseline retained count 4 and severity 3 together but with incomplete evidence. Evidence-focused run split them into separate vomiting records; quote support improved but structure and normalized values regressed.

persistent_failure.finding: Both prompts split vomiting count 1 and severity 3 into separate records; the existing normalizer does not merge the severity-only null-scope record with the daily count record.

repaired_fragmentation.finding: Baseline split count 3 and severity 1; evidence-focused output retained them together with a complete quote.

evaluator_alignment_note: Baseline TV007 nausea has all 11 expected semantic values, but its retained early quote does not overlap the final-sentence reference span.
